host.description: Use auto to select a private IPv4 address.

workspaceRoot.description: Default location for new project directories, not an access boundary. Administrators may register any absolute project path.

autoApprove.description: Automatically approve command execution, file changes, and requested permissions for the Codex session.

autoApproveBrowser.description: Allow local browser control for all CodexLAN conversations without approval cards, including signed-in websites. Codex browser policy still applies. Independent of autoApprove.
